title: The writer adds each step under the flow, with its order and links
description: The owner, or an agent, writes one `flow_step` record per step under the flow, following FORMAT.md section 13: its order, what happens, what it `uses` and what it `fulfills`.

title: The check reports a step order that is not a whole number or that two steps share
description: `lathe check` reports `step-order` errors, and a missing order as a missing required field.

title: The check compares what each step fulfills with the flow's use cases
description: A step that fulfills something outside the use cases its flow carries out is a `flow-step-fulfills-outside-flow` warning, which names what was compared.

title: The writer moves the flow's fulfills onto its steps, and the check reports any left over
description: Each `fulfills` link moves from the flow to the step that does it. A link left on the flow that no step has is a `flow-fulfills-differs-from-steps` warning.

title: The reader opens a flow's page and reads its steps in order
description: The flow's record page shows a Steps table: each step's order and ID, what happens, what it uses and what it fulfills.

title: They unfold a step to read more
description: Unfolding a row shows the step's description and the titles of what it uses and fulfills; a step with problems shows its badge.

title: In the Graph view the steps sit under the flow
description: The flow's steps are drawn one column to its right, directly, since they are its only kind of child.

title: Tracing a requirement, the reader sees the step that carries it out and its flow
description: Trace mode shows the step between its flow and the components it uses.

title: The reader sees each product as a space in the rail
description: The rail lists each product's icon or monogram in order; the current one has the accent bar.

title: They choose a space and the nav follows it
description: The nav now lists that product's domains, each folding into its Define and Design folders, and its groups.

title: They press Alt and a number to switch back, to the page they left
description: Or picks Switch to <product> in the command palette; the space opens on its last page this session.

title: They find a record in their space
description: Quick find lists the current space's matches only; another product is a choice in the rail.

title: They open the space's Checks
description: Checks in the nav's Tools opens the space's own Checks page: its product's problems, then the workspace's.

title: On a phone the rail stays in the drawer
description: The narrow-screen nav sheet keeps the rail beside the panel.

title: The reader rests on a control and its tooltip names its keys
description: After a short hover, or at once when they tab to it, the tooltip shows the control's name and keys.

title: They open the palette and read each command's keys
description: Each row shows its keys at the right in kbd styling.

title: A screen reader hears the keys
description: Each control with a shortcut carries `aria-keyshortcuts`.

title: They rebind a key and every hint follows
description: After a rebinding, the tooltips, the palette and the sheet show the new keys.
